mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coffee_log) AS coffee_log_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM music_log) AS music_log_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairing) AS pairing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM external_api_log WHERE success = FALSE) AS api_error_count

SELECT stat_date, SUM(coffee_count) AS coffee_count, SUM(music_count) AS music_count, SUM(pairing_count) AS pairing_count FROM ( SELECT drink_date AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS coffee_count, 0 AS music_count, 0 AS pairing_count FROM coffee_log WHERE drink_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY drink_date UNION ALL SELECT listened_date AS stat_date, 0 AS coffee_count, COUNT(*) AS music_count, 0 AS pairing_count FROM music_log WHERE listened_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY listened_date UNION ALL SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, 0 AS coffee_count, 0 AS music_count, COUNT(*) AS pairing_count FROM pairing WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ) stats GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date
